name: quill
description: Card-based post list, tags, reading time, a year-by-year archive, and a one-click light/dark toggle — in the spirit of the minimalist card-list blog themes popular in the static-site world.
author: GitPress

accentColor.description: Accent color for links, highlights and the active theme toggle.

showReadingTime.description: Show estimated reading time on post cards and post pages.

defaultAppearance.description: Initial light/dark appearance before the visitor's own toggle choice (saved in their browser) takes over.

showLogo.description: Show the site logo in the header when one is uploaded.

showAvatar.description: Show the site avatar in the header when one is uploaded.

showTitle.description: Show the site name next to the logo.

showTagline.description: Show the site description under the title.

showSearch.description: Show a Search link in the header.
